title: recurring dreams in china
content: i'm just now hearing about this mall world thing but it got me thinking about how most of my dreams are incredibly liminal and involve being in china??? it's always somewhere rather run down like a slum or shoddy apartments, kind of like the stuff you'd see around poorer parts of hong kong or shipai village in guangzhou. i've taken a lot of interest in china and modern chinese culture over the past 2 years, i'm not quite sure if it's because of the dreams or if it's the reason for the dreams, but it's definitely why i'm able to recognize the dreams are in china at all and a general idea of where i might possibly be within china. i think i'm just trying to understand it's significance to my subconscious or something. i'm not chinese nor have i ever been to china, what is my attachment to it???
